ops.text: cc-context go tests fail locally: mise gt shim (~/.local/share/mise/shims/gt) sits ahead of /opt/homebrew/bin/gt on PATH but gt is not active in this repo's mise config, so every gt-lane fixture dies at 'gt init' (mise ERROR gt is not a valid shim). Workaround: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH go test ./internal/cli. Hit by lane ccx-new-branch-parse, Oct 6.
